ai.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
ai.brief: OpenAI, Meta, and Google want AI agents to do everything for you. But popular services on the web aren’t letting that happen. OpenAI, Meta, and Google want AI agents to do everything for you. But popular services on the web aren’t letting that happen. Autonomous agents are the hottest thing in AI. OpenAI, Meta, Google, Instinct, and others promise their agents can scour the internet on your behalf, doing anything from booking a dinner reservation and cleaning out your inbox to buying new shoes. But what happens when the rest of the internet won’t play nice?
